title: Building lines needs permission, also checked when saving
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. Test users (set roles under Settings - Staff / Roles): one without "Work order lines - Create & Edit"; one without "Work orders - Create & Edit"; one without "See Financial Data".
  3. A completed inspection with at least one Monitor or Not OK finding, run on a work order. Seed it:
  4. ↳ Open a work order for a customer and asset (Work Orders > New, pick the customer/unit).
  5. ↳ Start an inspection from a template that has a checkbox field; mark one field Not OK and one Monitor.
  6. ↳ Complete and sign the inspection so it is in its read-only completed view.
custom_steps:
1. As the user without 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', confirm the Build lines action is not present on any entry point (the completed inspection screen, the work order note, and the asset Inspections tab).
2. As the user without 'Work orders - Create & Edit', confirm no 'new work order' option appears — only 'add lines to the open work order'.
3. As the user without 'See Financial Data', confirm the build still runs but the proposed-lines panel does not show the labor rate, the labor total or the part prices, while the rest of the panel is still editable and the lines can still be added.
4. Note for the tester: proving that the server itself refuses a hidden action (a request made without the interface) cannot be done by hand — it is a developer/automated check. By hand, confirm only that for each restricted user above the control is genuinely absent, not merely greyed out.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every withheld action is enforced by the server, so a request made without the permission is refused whatever the interface showed; hiding a control is presentation, not enforcement.
  • Without 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', the build is unavailable from every entry point.
  • Without 'Work orders - Create & Edit', the option to create a new work order is not shown; only "add lines to the open work order" is offered.
  • Without 'See Financial Data', the build still runs but the proposed-lines panel withholds the labor rate, labor total and part prices (server-enforced), while the rest stays editable and the lines can still be added.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9100 (S2 — Turn findings into work order lines); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S2; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R17: “Every rule in this document that withholds an action is enforced by the server. A request made without the permission is refused, whatever the interface showed. Hiding a control is how a rule is presented, not how it is enforced. This is stated once and applies to every story — the build, the destination choice, the asset Inspections tab, template authoring and Preview. The precedent is SV-7932, where a view-only user could invoke the ShopCoach line builder because only the button had been hidden”
  • S2-N3: “If the user does not have 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' enabled, the build will not be available from any entry point”
  • S2-N4: “If the user does not have 'Work orders - Create & Edit' enabled, the option to create a new work order will not be shown. They will only be offered the option to add lines to the open work order”
  • S2-N5: “If the user does not have 'See Financial Data' enabled, the build is still allowed and the money is not shown. The proposed-lines panel withholds the labor rate, the labor total and the part prices, and the withholding is enforced by the server rather than by leaving the fields out of the markup. Everything else in the panel stays editable and the lines can still be added”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
